verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents in-platform task assignment with deadlines. It also documents AI validation of uploaded evidence for timeliness, which flags outdated timestamps before an audit. Together these give manual evidence a thin owner/due-date and staleness check. However, nothing ties owners and due dates specifically to each manual artifact, and there are no recurring renewal reminders or expiry dates. missing for 10: per-artifact owner and due-date assignment for manual evidence, recurring renewal reminders, expiry-date tracking on evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, evidence that can't be automated has a real workflow — owners, due dates, renewal reminders, and expiry tracking on every manual artifact

citations.quote: Assign tasks, set deadlines, and work cross-functionally with your team and auditor in-platform.
Use Sprinto AI to automatically validate your uploaded evidence for relevance, scope, and timeliness before audit submission.
Sprinto AI analyses your submission and flags gaps such as outdated timestamps or irrelevant screenshots
